fix: Take the frames by reference: change the parameter to `frames: &[FrameRecordEvent],` (the body only calls `frames.iter()`). Then stop cloning the whole frame list in the caller: views.rs:232-236 builds `application_frames` with `state.frames.iter().cloned().collect()` on every snapshot rebuild while the Application view is active. Replace that field with the per-window counts computed under the lock (for example a `HashMap<WindowId, usize>` or a small Vec built from `state.frames` without cloning), and have build_application take those counts instead of frames. The current call passes the owned Vec, which forces the clone on every rebuild.

Move the title instead of cloning it: `Expanded::new(line_text(window.title, 13.5, text_primary())).into(),`. `window` is the by-value loop binding from `for window in windows`, and `window.title` is not used again in the loop body (the later uses are `id`, `logical_size` and `scale_factor`, which are not affected by the partial move).
